# unifi_setting_ips_mode (Resource)

Manages only the ips_mode field of the IPS singleton through the legacy API. Preserves all other settings. Do not combine with the full unifi_setting_ips resource for the same site. Destroy relinquishes ownership without changing the controller. Import uses site:setting-id; no backend migration is performed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Do not combine with the full setting resource for the same site.
resource "unifi_setting_ips_mode" "example" {
  site     = "default"
  ips_mode = "ips"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ips_mode` (String) Detection mode: `ids` notifies, `ips` notifies and blocks, and `disabled` disables inspection. Preserves network and category selections. Existing `ipsInline` values can be read and migrated, but cannot be configured here.

### Optional

- `site` (String) The name of the UniFi site where this resource should be applied. If not specified, the default site will be used.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# Replace the illustrative ID with the existing singleton ID for this site.
tofu import unifi_setting_ips_mode.example default:ips-fixture-id
```
